assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like-particle HPV vaccines represent a decisive preventive intervention against infection and HPV-related cancer, with exceptionally broad public-health consequence.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed laureates provide a coherent attribution for the enabling virology, vaccine concept, and translation.
assessment.maturity: The protective principle and population-level clinical impact have been established over many years.
uncertainties: The supplied record does not resolve the relative contributions of all contributors to vaccine development.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Establishing TNF blockade transformed treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and created a durable therapeutic paradigm for inflammatory disease.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini form a focused and intelligible attribution for the mechanistic rationale and clinical demonstration.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic effect, mechanism, and extension across inflammatory disorders are long established.
uncertainties: The record gives limited detail on the contributions of other investigators and industrial partners.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The identification of distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages supplied a foundational framework for adaptive immunity and modern immunopathology.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are a compact attribution for the complementary lymphocyte-lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The findings have been repeatedly confirmed and have structured immunology for decades.
uncertainties: The supplied summary does not specify the boundaries between the principal discoveries and subsequent lineage research.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic advance for diabetes and obesity while illuminating a central metabolic signaling system.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker provide a defensible three-person attribution spanning discovery, molecular definition, and physiological development.
assessment.maturity: The biology and clinical benefits are extensively established, including across large patient populations.
uncertainties: Attribution between basic GLP-1 discovery, drug design, and clinical translation remains difficult to delimit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition converted chronic myeloid leukemia into a model for rational molecularly targeted cancer treatment.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates credibly cover inhibitor development, clinical proof, and the broader therapeutic validation of the target.
assessment.maturity: Long-term patient outcomes and the general targeted-therapy paradigm provide strong confirmation.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not fully separate contributions to target discovery from those to drug development and clinical implementation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed how cells sense and respond to endoplasmic-reticulum stress, with wide importance in cell physiology and disease.
assessment.attribution: Mori and Walter are an appropriately limited attribution for the core signaling discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The pathway is mechanistically established across model systems and has had sustained biological influence.
uncertainties: Translation of this broad cell-biological insight into decisive disease interventions remains variable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted protein folding established a fundamental mechanism by which cells achieve productive protein folding.
assessment.attribution: Horwich and Hartl are directly and clearly associated with the central chaperonin work.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has been extensively replicated and integrated into modern molecular cell biology.
uncertainties: The supplied summary does not detail how credit should be apportioned among the wider protein-folding field.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA in maternal blood made noninvasive prenatal screening possible and changed prenatal molecular diagnostics.
assessment.attribution: The single proposed laureate offers a clear attribution for the central discovery.
assessment.maturity: The method has undergone extensive clinical adoption and validation.
uncertainties: Screening performance and implementation differ across clinical settings and indications.
